pruneRule: An id is prune-listed when it flips on MORE THAN ONE distinct exemplar; a flip is minority presence, the id appearing in 1 or 2 of the 3 passes on one exemplar.
operationalization: The design doc sentence "flip in more than 1 of 3 passes on any exemplar" cannot bind per-exemplar with 3 passes (minority presence is the only observable flip), so the threshold is operationalized ACROSS exemplars: at most one flip event per (id, exemplar), prune when the events span more than one distinct exemplar.
note: Report only: config.mjs is never edited by this script; the human applies the prune.
